story.fullStory:
Phil Collins's "In The Air Tonight" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. "In the Air Tonight" is a song by the English drummer and singer-songwriter Phil Collins.

It was released as the lead single from Collins's debut solo studio album, Face Value, in January 1981.

It was selected as the second single from the album in the United States and Canada, after "I Missed Again".

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Philip David Charles Collins (born 30 January 1951) is an English singer, drummer, songwriter, record producer, and actor.
He was the drummer and later became the lead singer of the rock band Genesis and had a successful solo career, achieving three UK number-one singles and seven US number-one singles as a solo artist.
In total, his work with Genesis, other artists and solo resulted in more US top-40 singles than any other artist throughout the 1980s.
